specification fp32_rms_one_row_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (p : Parameters) (s : State α) (hxd : p.dx≠p.dw) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (rmsKernel p) s=some t ∧ t.mem=(rowReference M p s Bool.false).mem ∧
      (∀ i : TileIndex [p.block],i.1.val<p.columns →
        t.mem p.dx (offset s p.dxStride i)=stored M (rowDX M p s Bool.false i) ∧
        t.mem p.dw (offset s p.columns i)=stored M (rowDW M p s Bool.false i)) ∧
      (∀ r o, RowOutside p s Bool.false r o → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification fp32_plain_one_row_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (p : Parameters) (s : State α) (hxd : p.dx≠p.dw) (hxb : p.dx≠p.db) (hdb : p.dw≠p.db) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (plainKernel p) s=some t ∧ t.mem=(rowReference M p s Bool.true).mem ∧
      (∀ i : TileIndex [p.block],i.1.val<p.columns →
        t.mem p.dx (offset s p.dxStride i)=stored M (rowDX M p s Bool.true i) ∧
        t.mem p.dw (offset s p.columns i)=stored M (rowDW M p s Bool.true i) ∧
        t.mem p.db (offset s p.columns i)=stored M (rowDB M p s i)) ∧
      (∀ r o, RowOutside p s Bool.true r o → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification fp32_c1_reduction_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (p : Parameters) (s : State α) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (c1Kernel p) s=some t ∧
      t.mem p.c1 (s.pids 0)=stored M (c1Value M p s) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r≠p.c1 ∨ o≠s.pids 0) → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification fp32_c2_reduction_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (p : Parameters) (s : State α) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (c2Kernel p) s=some t ∧
      t.mem p.c2 (s.pids 0)=stored M (rowC2 M p s) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r≠p.c2 ∨ o≠s.pids 0) → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification fp32_supplied_dx_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (p : Parameters) (s : State α) (plain : Bool) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (if plain then plainDXKernel p else rmsDXKernel p) s=some t ∧
      (∀ i : TileIndex [p.block],i.1.val<p.columns →
        t.mem p.dx (offset s p.dxStride i)=stored M (suppliedDX M p s plain i)) ∧
      (∀ r o, OutsideVector p s p.dx p.dxStride r o → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification fp32_residual_add_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (p : Parameters) (s : State α) (h : p.dresIn≠p.dx) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (residualKernel p) s=some t ∧
      (∀ i : TileIndex [p.block],i.1.val<p.columns →
        t.mem p.dx (offset s p.dxStride i)=stored M (residualValue M p s i) ∧
        t.mem p.dresIn (offset s p.dresInStride i)=stored M (residualValue M p s i)) ∧
      (∀ r o, (OutsideVector p s p.dx p.dxStride r o ∧
        OutsideVector p s p.dresIn p.dresInStride r o) → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification supplied_vector_store_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (pre out : RegionName) (stride N B : Nat) (s : State α) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (vectorStore .fp32 pre out stride N B) s=some t ∧
      (∀ i : TileIndex [B],i.1.val<N → t.mem out (offset s stride i)=
        .mk .fp32 ((s.mem pre (offset s stride i)).read .fp32)) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r≠out ∨ ∀ i : TileIndex [B],i.1.val<N → o≠offset s stride i) →
        t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification supplied_mean_store_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (pre out : RegionName) (s : State α) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (meanStore .fp32 pre out) s=some t ∧
      t.mem out (s.pids 0)=.mk .fp32 ((s.mem pre (s.pids 0)).read .fp32) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r≠out ∨ o≠s.pids 0) → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification supplied_rstd_store_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (pre out : RegionName) (s : State α) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (rstdStore .fp32 pre out) s=some t ∧
      t.mem out (s.pids 0)=.mk .fp32 ((s.mem pre (s.pids 0)).read .fp32) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r≠out ∨ o≠s.pids 0) → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

compile.mode: direct lake env lean -o; isolated imports; no lake build

scope.forward: The accepted headlines are independent supplied Y/ResidualOut/Mean/Rstd stores. All are covered as successful typed-cell executions with exact value and frame. Their normalization/residual producers remain external; no full forward arithmetic claim.
scope.backward_rows: RMS no-bias and plain-bias single-row source graphs include supplied statistics, X/DY/W load/casts, actual xhat mask, W undef tail, W*DY, full C1(/C2) reductions/divisions, DX, actual +0 DW/DB accumulation, final fp32 stores and frame. Arbitrary N/B/pid/strides; active output readback uses original output-region separation; contiguous lane offset injectivity proved.
scope.backward_stages: Independent C1/C2 reduction output contracts, independent supplied C1(/C2)/Rstd/Xhat -> DX, and supplied DXBase+DRESIDUAL -> DX/DRESIDUAL_IN. No stage-composition assumption that a supplied value is another stage result.
scope.excluded: Full multi-row backward loop, host DW/DB aggregation, forward value producers absent from the old headlines, launch/layout composition, non-fp32 dtype configurations, native GPU conformance.
scope.memory: All new arithmetic and supplied-store entries prove successful Structural execution with independent initial-cell values and memory frame. Original IO safety/layout statements remain unchanged; no new typed IO skin is claimed.
scope.padding: No live-only sum or finite-input assumption. W tail is address-indexed undef; every full BLOCK_N product/reduction is retained, including possible zero times Inf/NaN. Padded Xhat is source where(...,0), not an algebraic zero-product simplification.

numerical_model.parameterized: Per-operation callbacks on opaque alpha, preserving dtype/cast/precision and full reduction array. Independent expressions and write sequence, not source=source equivalence.
numerical_model.software: ScalarOps fp32 add/sub/mul/div, bit-preserving same-fp32 carrier casts, explicit ascending-lane +0-seeded reduction; source literal 0/1 fixed and other literal conversion named. No sqrt/rsqrt is used in these accepted supplied-statistic stages.
numerical_model.instantiation_limits: General public declarations are backend value contracts. Concrete witnesses use N=1, so every used numerical callback, including literals and reductions, is fixed independently of rest. They are checked examples of complete stage execution, not universal hardware correspondence.

witnesses.signed_zero: Actual complete plain one-row execution N=1/B=2 with DY=-0, X=W=Rstd=1, Mean=0: DX=-0, DW=+0, DB=+0; DX[1] framed. Removing +0 changes DW/DB bits; an explicit checked counterexample records the difference.
witnesses.rounding: Actual residual-add dual-output execution with DXBase=1 and DRESIDUAL=2^-25 writes both outputs as 1, while the exact rational sum differs.
witnesses.method: decide +kernel plus actual successful-execution contracts; no native_decide.

native_obligations.bind: Bind source tensors and partial DW/DB/statistics to fp32, original row-stage configuration and valid input/output extents/strides. Preserve supplied-stage and one-row boundaries.

Pin Triton/compiler/CUDA/architecture, generated PTX/cubin and flags; correct rounding, FTZ, signed-zero, nonfinite and NaN behavior. Software uses separately rounded operations; actual fusion/division approximation must match or receive its own operation graph.
Bind N integer-to-fp32 scalar conversion in the row reductions. No global conversion identity or finite-domain restriction is added.
Bind actual full BLOCK_N/layout/numWarps-dependent C1/C2 reduction schedule, seed and leaf order; ascending-lane software plan is not asserted equal to GPU reduction.
Preserve the real Python +0 DW/DB initialization and add, including signed-zero behavior. The old product-only/term-only graph is not interchangeable over all bit patterns.
Preserve W masked-without-other input and every padded operation; no replacement with zero and no finite-input precondition.
